Video Title: Bitcoin Surges Above $85K: Analyzing TWAP Gravity and the Bear Market Clock  
Video ID: cWmFF5wkYRg  
Bitcoin (BTC) | Class: CRYPTO  

Current Structure  
Bitcoin is trading just above $85,000, sitting roughly 191% above its time‑weighted average price (TWAP) and firmly within a deep accumulation zone. The 90‑day momentum is up 37%, while the composite risk score stands at 29/100 and Bitcoin’s market impact is a striking 85 out of 100. Social sentiment is bullish, with the fear‑and‑greed index at 70/100 and a 30‑day trend trending upward.  

Macro Quantitative Risk  
TWAP baseline is approximately $30,000, with Bitcoin currently trading at a premium of about 191% and a TWAP risk level of 8. Regression‑based fair value places the price roughly $10,000 above the fair‑value line, with a regression risk of 0.9 (over‑valuation zone). Historical risk‑level mapping shows risk level 1 in 2014‑15, 2 at 105% TWAP in 2018, and 3 at 30‑35% TWAP in 2022; the current risk level suggests a potential bottom at risk level 4‑5 with an 80% premium.  

Downside & Upside Targets  
Machine‑learning forecasts place a non‑panic 10‑week floor at $74,000, a panic floor near $60,000, and a worst‑case floor of $48,000 (risk level 4 bottom). The base‑case rally target for the next 10 weeks is around $92,000, with a 10‑week upside forecast of roughly $13,000 above current levels. Long‑term cycle bull targets project a maximum euphoria range of $172,000 (2029‑2030) and a realistic peak between $143,000 and $183,000, while a conservative base‑case bull target sits near $160,000‑$180,000. The current base‑bear target is near $50,000, extendable to $54,000, reflecting the 85% completion of the current bear cycle.
